request: Close both lower cockpit sides, then reflect the reference photograph with a more A-shaped dashboard/support, before-takeoff/before-landing card and warning tag.

reference.provenance: User-supplied photograph; author and airframe not provided. Inspected for green sheet-metal walls, rails, black footboards, trim wheels and right-side equipment, plus the tapered dashboard, silver support and two placards. Checklist and warning wording transcribed visually. No photograph pixels embedded.
reference.calibration: Qualitative comparison; no surveyed dimensions or matched-camera overlay. Existing airframe dimensions, pilot eye and gauge positions retained. Card spacing fits below the forward eye ray; sight housing lowered behind the card.

diagnosis: The existing fuselage-interior mesh supplied inward normals but outward triangle winding. Backface culling hid it from the pilot. The wing crown also intersected the lower cockpit floor.
changes: Reverse lining winding to match the inward normals.
Fit green side panels, ribs, canopy channels and fasteners inside the fuselage.
Add a forward footwell bulkhead, left trim wheels and right electrical/oxygen fittings.
Raise and fit the floor and dark footboards above the wing crown; raise the fuel-selector plate clear of them.
Batch the new static sidewall fittings by material while retaining existing animated and interactive controls.
Narrow the instrument-panel crown and replace the shallow black hoop with a silver support with long sloping legs.
Add a mounted two-column BEFORE TAKE OFF / BEFORE LANDING checklist and cream WARNING placard above the instruments.
method: Deterministic three.js geometry; reuse the existing procedural cockpit finishes and period font atlas. No image-generation prompt and no new texture library.

checks: 16 aircraft-shell checks pass for source/imported enclosure, inward normals, floor clearance, exterior skin and forward glazing.
2 aircraft-interactions checks pass across source/runtime aircraft, including physical-control reachability.
Asset inspect --verify passes; review scene validates and simulates for 30 ticks.
A second deterministic generator run matches the source SHA-256 byte-for-byte.
Biome and git diff --check pass on the changed source and tests.
commands: node packages/tooling/dist/cli.mjs asset import content/entities/source/aircraft/p-51/models/source.glb --id molen.entities.aircraft.p51d --project content/entities/project.json --force
node packages/tooling/dist/cli.mjs asset inspect molen.entities.aircraft.p51d --project content/entities/project.json --verify

node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run test/aircraft-shell.test.mjs test/vehicle-interiors.test.mjs test/cockpit-surfaces.test.mjs test/aircraft-interactions.test.mjs --no-file-parallelism (from packages/entities)
validation.environment: Node 24.21.0, existing package builds. Direct Vitest entry point used because Corepack pnpm download was unavailable; Chromium captures used PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH and local loopback access.

visualReview.decision: Accepted: the dashboard/support now has a narrow crown and sloping legs; both checklist columns and the warning are visible above the gauges. The lower cockpit remains enclosed, controls remain visible and the forward visibility check passes.

limitations: Reference-informed medium-fi approximation, not a serial-specific restoration or exact cockpit replica.
The new trim wheels, oxygen hose and electrical fittings are visual details; existing flight-control bindings remain functional.
Targeted model review only; full engine CI and aggregate asset rebuild deferred to the batch milestone.
